Junior Vue.js Developer
Company: Zephyr Web

We are an agency building marketing websites for local businesses. Looking for a Junior Vue.js Developer to grow with us.

On-site in Lviv (office near the city center).
Salary: UAH 30,000-40,000 per month, depending on skills.

What we expect:
- Basic knowledge of Vue 3 and JavaScript
- HTML, CSS, Tailwind
- Ability to work with Figma designs
- English at reading level

Nice to have: Nuxt, TypeScript.
